query:
SELECT
            sender_name AS "sender_name!",
            COUNT(*) AS "count!: i64",
            MAX(id) AS "latest_id!: i64"
        FROM
            media_posts
        WHERE
            chat_id = ?1
            AND (?2 IS NULL OR created_at >= ?2)
        GROUP BY
            sender_id
        ORDER BY
            COUNT(*) DESC,
            MAX(id) DESC
        LIMIT
            ?3
